product_overview: A Laravel-based multi-branch backend for point-of-sale, inventory synchronization, stock transfers, and real-time double-entry accounting. It supports authenticated branch-scoped product/catalog operations, checkout posting, and journal creation for retail finance workflows.
core_goals: Provide secure Sanctum-based authentication and branch-aware user context.
Manage branches, categories, and products with CRUD APIs scoped to the authenticated user.
Support barcode-based product lookup for fast POS operations.
Enable inter-branch stock transfer workflows and inventory distribution.
Process POS checkouts that reduce stock, generate receipts, and post accounting journals.
Record balanced double-entry journal entries for financial reporting and ledger updates.

features.name: Authentication API
features.description: Allows users to log in, obtain a Sanctum bearer token, access their profile, and log out securely.
user_flows: POST /api/login with valid email and password -> Receive 200 with Sanctum bearer token and user role -> GET /api/user with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with authenticated user profile and assigned branch -> POST /api/logout with Bearer token -> Receive 200 confirming token revocation
POST /api/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> GET /api/user without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthenticated response

features.name: Branch Management API
features.description: Supports viewing, creating, updating, and deleting store branches for multi-store administration.
user_flows: POST /api/login with master credentials -> Receive 200 with Bearer token -> GET /api/branches with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with list of active branches -> POST /api/branches with valid branch data -> Receive 201 with created branch details -> PUT /api/branches/{branch} with updated settings -> Receive 200 with updated branch metadata

POST /api/branches without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> PUT /api/branches/{branch} with invalid or incomplete data -> Receive 422 validation error response -> DELETE /api/branches/{branch} for a branch with dependent records -> Receive server-enforced deletion response based on branch constraints

features.name: Categories Management API
features.description: Manages the product category tree used to organize catalog items.
user_flows: POST /api/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with Bearer token -> GET /api/categories -> Receive 200 with category tree -> POST /api/categories with valid category payload -> Receive 201 with created category -> PUT /api/categories/{category} with updated attributes -> Receive 200 with updated category details

POST /api/categories without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> POST /api/categories with invalid payload -> Receive 422 validation error response -> DELETE /api/categories/{category} for a category with constraints -> Receive server-enforced deletion response based on category rules

features.name: Products Management API
features.description: Provides branch-scoped catalog browsing, barcode lookup, and full CRUD for products.
user_flows: POST /api/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with Bearer token -> GET /api/products with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with products scoped to the current branch -> GET /api/products/barcode/{barcode} with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with matching product details -> POST /api/products with valid product data -> Receive 201 with created product record -> PUT /api/products/{product} with updated pricing and SKU data -> Receive 200 with updated product information

GET /api/products without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> GET /api/products/barcode/{barcode} with unknown barcode -> Receive 404 not found response -> POST /api/products with invalid data -> Receive 422 validation error response -> DELETE /api/products/{product} for an existing catalog item -> Receive 200 or 204 based on deletion handling

features.name: Stock Transfer API
features.description: Handles inter-branch inventory transfer requests and retrieval of transfer manifests.
user_flows: POST /api/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with Bearer token -> POST /api/stock-transfers with source branch, destination branch, and items -> Receive 201 with created transfer request -> GET /api/stock-transfers -> Receive 200 with list of transfer requests -> GET /api/stock-transfers/{stockTransfer} -> Receive 200 with transfer details and line items

POST /api/stock-transfers without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> POST /api/stock-transfers with missing product or branch references -> Receive 422 validation error response -> GET /api/stock-transfers/{stockTransfer} for a non-existent transfer -> Receive 404 not found response

features.name: Point of Sale Checkout API
features.description: Processes POS cart checkout, updates inventory, and creates the related sales journal entry.
user_flows: POST /api/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with Bearer token -> POST /api/checkout with cart items, payment method, discount_amount, and paid_amount -> Receive 200 with sale invoice data, reduced branch stock, and generated journal entry
POST /api/checkout with quantity greater than available stock -> Receive 422 validation error response -> Confirm no sale is created, stock remains unchanged, and no journal is posted

POST /api/checkout with client-supplied unit price different from master price -> Receive 200 with server-recomputed pricing based on master product price -> Receive sale response with corrected line pricing and totals

features.name: Accounting Journals API
features.description: Posts balanced double-entry journal records for financial ledger updates and accounting controls.
user_flows: POST /api/login with master credentials -> Receive 200 with Bearer token -> POST /api/journals with balanced debit and credit lines -> Receive 201 with posted journal record -> GET /api/user with Bearer token -> Receive 200 confirming authenticated master context

POST /api/journals with unbalanced debit and credit totals -> Receive 422 validation error response -> POST /api/journals without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> POST /api/journals with admin-branch token where master access is required -> Receive 403 forbidden response

known_limitations.issue: No written study of Odoo or ERPNext finance and inventory table relations
known_limitations.impact: Schema decisions are internal ADRs only, so gaps versus a proven ERP model are not documented

known_limitations.issue: A product with sales history can still be removed from the catalog
known_limitations.impact: deleteProduct soft-deletes the product and deletes its inventory rows, so the restrict foreign key on sale items never blocks the catalog delete

known_limitations.issue: Customer master can be deleted while sales history exists
known_limitations.impact: sales.customer_id uses nullOnDelete and CustomerController::destroy does not block deletion

known_limitations.issue: Some product and branch foreign keys cascade instead of restrict
known_limitations.impact: Deleting a product cascades inventory rows, and deleting a branch cascades journals, sales, and warehouses

known_limitations.issue: POS line price, line subtotal, and sale total are integers while journals use DECIMAL
known_limitations.impact: Fractional rupiah is rounded away on the sale document even though journal lines keep two decimal places

known_limitations.issue: Checkout accepts client discount_amount and paid_amount
known_limitations.impact: Unit price is recomputed on the server, but discount and partial payment amounts still originate from the client and are only bounded

known_limitations.issue: Branch admin can post a manual journal
known_limitations.impact: finance/journals.store is behind manage-branch-operations, so journal creation is not limited to master. There is no journal update, delete, or reversal route locked to master

known_limitations.issue: No repeated stress suite for partial return, tiered discount, and split payment
known_limitations.impact: Existing PHPUnit and TestSprite plans cover a single discount, AP installments, zero stock, and a balanced balance sheet, but not those three combined scenarios

known_limitations.issue: Final entity-relationship rationale and recurring calculation bugs are only partly written down
known_limitations.impact: BUG-001 through BUG-005 do not record the decimal scaling bug or the null-branch backoffice failure, and there is no final ER diagram
